goal: Finish a bounded methods/application paper using owned data. No claim of new cosmic tilt, Bianchi identification or information advantage over exact GLS.

execution_policy.live_other_session: Do not change branch/tree while another writer is live. Finish owner handoff or stage a small patch; record exact blocker, never kill unrelated work.
execution_policy.historical_R57_stop: Preserved; this explicit owner request authorizes only R58/R59 bounded successor.
execution_policy.general_controller_autodispatch: Disabled for R58/R59 scope after final manuscript decision; unrelated DAG remains unchanged.

model.physical_map: build_r58_views.physical_map; verify n convention and congruence before physical use
model.coefficient_design: X_m=O_m [g(z)n, n, STF5(n)] includes leakage into every row
model.covariance: full32 fixed existing measurement + LCDM cosmic cache
model.likelihood: fixed-C Gaussian; carrier J,t,q0,logdet and stable whitened factors; no prior in parameter_scale
model.rank_policy: no ridge; compare scaled and unit-equilibrated rank, fail on discrepancy; kernel contrast gives infinite interval

nulls.adequacy: 21 residual dof, only under declared11-param model

model.nuisance_combination: union confidence bodies; max p for SAME null; interval hull is not full joint region
model.independence: never multiply models or the 5 views as independent experiments

frames.sigma: STF orthonormal R54 basis; sigma/H dimensionless
frames.omega: angular-frequency omega/H; scalar distance no linear response
frames.acceleration: A/(cH); dH has free calibration dipole and is not identified A

frozen_inputs: scripts/r58/run_r58_owned_tensor.py:PINS; ALLOWED_REPAIRED_HASHES only exact reviewed finite-MC helper

remaining_tasks.acceptance: 35970 groups;7 variants;all11 ranks;frozen marginal error<2e-7; scientific result tolerance rtol1e-7 atol1e-9, no tolerance change to conceal drift. Cache float fingerprint may differ only with exact source/labels/model and required numeric parity.

Otherwise record unresolved survey coverage and finish the conditional manuscript; do not implement unrelated competitors.
remaining_tasks.acceptance: No declared method win from the five correlated views; distinguish algebraic tie, conditional coverage effect, empirical application finding and not-comparable physics.

remaining_tasks.action: Write MANUSCRIPT.md or .tex and CLAIM_TABLE.csv for narrow owned-CF4 joint-covariance/calibration application; integrate six-lane limitations and primary citations. Any calibration metadata already locally present may be used only if its effect is source-bound and test selected before looking at its new p-value; otherwise retain conditional scope.
remaining_tasks.acceptance: Every result traceable to outputs; E diagnostic, omega/kernel unbounded, no arbitrary-tilt or Bianchi claim, no all-systematics guarantee; do not require unavailable data to write the bounded paper.

remaining_tasks.action: One independent manuscript/claim review; fix material findings; decide BOUNDED_METHODS_APPLICATION or NO_PAPER with actual comparison table; commit and non-force push; mark R59 complete_scoped and STOP.
remaining_tasks.acceptance: No automatic R60/audit-only extension; new science requires new owner scope.

mutation_gates.required: written hypothesis, source identity, units/frame, identifiability and independent numerical check before claim use
stop affected calculation; classify byte vs numerical vs semantic mismatch; do not edit input cache, expected hash or tolerance to pass

mutation_gates.trigger: statistical decision, new nuisance model or cut
mutation_gates.required: record before new result; mark exploratory unless independent existing holdout supports decision; no fishing for significance
scoped tests + independent diff/claim review + clean owned staged paths; non-force push only; no main merge
explicit assumptions/proof/transfer/source; code PASS never suffices

anti_drift_self_audit: Read exact current files before changing them.
No invented data, source citations, posterior, likelihood independence, native launch or test receipt.
Do not substitute all-J covariance for the actual physical transfer.
Do not relabel support ratio as occupancy; if no physical admissible body+measure, F_occupancy remains UNAVAILABLE.
Preserve q0 and logdet and null-space information.
Do not identify apparent kappa with shear or dH with acceleration when calibration is free.
CONST_V exclusion is not all-tilt exclusion; zero omega column is no constraint.
State nuisance-union coverage assumptions and posthoc status.
No systematic measurement zero-filled because absent.
Keep prior-driven marginal shrinkage distinct from data identification.
No scope drift into fresh data acquisition or native ODE solver.
On failure classify THEORY, NUMERICAL, IMPLEMENTATION, ENVIRONMENT, INPUT, PERMISSION and retain original failure.
stop: After R59-D final decision, finish. Physical goals without identified response remain explicit limits, not new automatic work.

independent_replay.path_defaults: --root defaults to the repository inferred from this script; --results and --output default under R58. --candidate-root defaults to --root and is only needed for a separately staged cloud patch.
independent_replay.scope: The original independently implemented numerical oracle is unchanged; this is executable replay, not a request to implement a new oracle. Native output is separate from committed receipts.
independent_replay.conditional_calibration: Gaussian full/split calibration has already been executed with independent seeds. Replaying it verifies the environment; it does not newly validate survey coverage or true covariance.
